observability_triage.rationale: Component retention under a drop can be reduced to objective enclosure, mount, and test-fixture facts, but the environment contains only a PCB artifact. It has no enclosure CAD, fastener interfaces, component envelopes, assembly procedure, or frozen drop-test protocol; the phrase 'easy to assemble' also has no supplied objective threshold.
repair_requirements: Add a versioned enclosure CAD artifact with board, battery, display, sensor, button, and LED retention features.
Define a deterministic assembly protocol and measurable usability limits if assembly ease is to be scored.
Define a frozen drop orientation, height, surface, repetition count, and post-drop displacement/continuity checks.

evidence: No enclosure or mount geometry is generated.
A PCB outline alone cannot establish retention of every device component after a drop.
No objective definition of easy assembly is provided.
missing_observables: Enclosure retention geometry for every component
